questions.q: Which tribe would be given the land on the northern border of Israel?
questions.a: The tribe of Dan would be given the land on the northern border of Israel.

questions.q: Which tribe would be south of the border of the tribe of Dan?
questions.a: The tribe of Asher would be south of the border of Dan.

questions.q: Which tribe would be south of the border of the tribe of Asher?
questions.a: The tribe of Naphtali would be south of the border of Asher.

questions.q: In order, which four tribes would be south of the tribe of Naphtali?
questions.a: In order, the four tribes south of Naphtali would be Manasseh, Ephraim, Reuben, and Judah.

questions.q: What would be in the middle of the land located along the border with Judah?
questions.a: The temple would be in the middle of the land located along the border with Judah.

questions.q: Who would live on the land surrounding the sanctuary of Yahweh?
questions.a: The priests of the line of Zadok would live on the land surrounding the sanctuary of Yahweh.

questions.q: Who would live on the land bordering the priests’ land?
questions.a: The Levites would live on the land bordering the priests’ land.

questions.q: For what would the remaining area of the holy offering of land be used?
questions.a: The remaining area of the holy offering of land would be used to produce food for those working in the city.

questions.q: For whom would be the land on the eastern and western borders of the holy offering of land?
questions.a: The land on the eastern and western borders of the holy offering of land would be for the prince.

questions.q: What was to be the southern boundary of Gad?
questions.a: The southern boundary of Gad was to extend from Tamar to the waters of Meribah Kadesh, and farther to the brook of Egypt, and then to the Great Sea.

questions.q: How many gates were to be on the north side of the city, and what were they to be named for?
questions.a: There would be three gates on the north side of the city, with one being named for Reuben, one for Judah, and one for Levi.

questions.q: What would be the city’s name?
questions.a: The city’s name would be “Yahweh is There.”

commentary.text: Here is a description of the several portions of the land belonging to each tribe. In gospel times, behold all things are become new. Much is wrapped up in emblems and numbers. This method God has used to state mysterious truths in his word, not to be more clearly revealed till the proper time and season. But into the church of Christ, both in its state of warfare and triumph, there is free access by faith, from every side. Christ has opened the kingdom of heaven for all believers. Whoever will, may come, and take of the water of life, of the tree of life, freely. The Lord is there, in his church, to be nigh unto them in all they call upon him for. This is true of every real Christian; whatever soul has in it a living principle of grace, it may truly be said, The Lord is there. May we be found citizens of this holy city, and act agreeably to that character; and have the benefit of the Lord's presence with us, in life, in death, and for evermore.
